introduction.title: Pendahuluan
introduction.description: Aether adalah control plane operasi sosial enterprise untuk Instagram, Threads, dan TikTok.

sections.title: Apa itu Aether?
sections.body: Aether adalah satu workspace untuk operasi engagement sosial. Alih-alih berpindah antar aplikasi native hanya untuk meninjau komentar, menyetujui draf, merotasi sesi, atau mempublikasikan konten, operator mengelola semuanya dari satu control plane yang dapat diaudit dan ber-guardrail.

sections.title: Yang bisa Anda lakukan
bullets: Lihat akun, sesi, kampanye, persetujuan, dan aktivitas di satu tempat.
Hasilkan draf komentar kontekstual dengan AI hybrid (gateway + fallback lokal).
Setujui, edit, dan atur irama aksi outbound sebelum dipublikasikan.
Jalankan kampanye auto-post pada interval tetap dengan visibilitas jadwal.
Gunakan mode simulator untuk demo/CI, lalu beralih ke webhook atau konektor resmi untuk live.
Ekspor audit log dan terapkan batas penggunaan bulanan.

sections.title: Untuk siapa?
bullets: Tim growth dan social ops yang butuh otomasi terkendali.
Agensi yang mengelola banyak akun brand dengan alur persetujuan.
Operator enterprise yang butuh RBAC, jejak audit, dan dukungan review keamanan.

sections.title: Dua cara memakai Aether
sections.body: Ikuti Tutorial untuk mengoperasikan semuanya dari dashboard, atau gunakan Referensi API untuk memicu worker, menerima webhook publish, dan mengintegrasikan notifikasi billing ke stack Anda sendiri.

quick-start.title: Mulai Cepat
quick-start.description: Dari nol hingga demo simulator yang berjalan dalam satu sesi.

sections.title: Install and boot
sections.code:
npm install
npx prisma generate
npx prisma db push
npm run dev

sections.title: First operator path
bullets: Add a proxy and social akun under sesi Routing.

sections.title: Switching toward live
sections.body: Keep SIMULATOR_MODE=true until the persetujuan flow is trusted. lalu set SIMULATOR_MODE=false, configure SOCIAL_PUBLISH_WEBHOOK_URL (and opsional official API tokens), and test from /app/pengaturan/publisher.

sections.title: Operator checklist
steps: Confirm .env.local has DATABASE_URL, AUTH_*, ENCRYPTION_KEY, WORKER_SECRET.
Run prisma generate + db push, lalu npm run dev.
Sign up with Google and buat a workspace.
Add proxy + social akun, lalu buat a kampanye/listener.
Run worker:tick and review /app/persetujuan + /app/activity.
Only lalu flip SIMULATOR_MODE=false for live konektor.

concepts.title: Konsep Inti
concepts.description: The building blocks Anda will see across the product.

sections.title: Workspace
sections.body: Every business object is scoped to a workspace. Memberships define role permissions (owner, admin, operator, analyst, auditor, viewer).

sections.title: Routing Sesi
sections.body: akun, encrypted sesi vaults, proxy, health checks, and rotation logs. This is the foundation for safe multi-akun operations.

sections.title: Comment Engine
sections.body: listener discover target posts, agents generate drafts, persetujuan gate sending, and worker execute paced outbound actions.

sections.title: konektor plane
sections.body: Hybrid routing chooses simulator, webhook, or official adapters per action. mode live fails closed when credentials are missing.

sections.title: Agents, knowledge, skills
sections.body: Agents carry persona/guardrails. Knowledge documents are chunked and retrieved into generation. Skills can inject tool results with chain-of-thought steps.

sections.title: Self-serve plans
bullets: 6 Months: best balance for growing operator teams.
12 Months: lowest bulanan rate for stable production.

sections.title: Checkout
sections.body: Checkout uses Midtrans Snap with opsional voucher. Orders activate plan limits after settlement (or local simulation when Midtrans keys are absent).

sections.title: Enterprise
sections.body: Custom quotas, keamanan review support, SSO, and guided onboarding are available via /enterprise and sales contact flows.

accounts-proxies.title: Akun & Proxy
accounts-proxies.description: Connect social akun records and bind healthy egress.

sections.title: Social akun
sections.body: buat akun records for Instagram, Threads, or TikTok. Status and health score update from worker probes.

sections.title: proxy
sections.body: Add proxy endpoints, assign them to akun, and track rotation/health. Sticky vs rotate modes are supported in the data model.

sections.title: Secrets
sections.body: sesi blobs and sensitive values are encrypted with ENCRYPTION_KEY. Never store plaintext credentials in notes fields.

sections.title: Health checks
sections.body: worker job sesi.health_check probes active sesi and proxy health, writes SessionHealthCheck rows, and can emit notifications on degradation.

sections.title: proxy rotation
sections.body: proxy.rotate advances IPs for non-sticky assignments and records IpRotationLog entries for auditability.

connectors.title: konektor
connectors.description: Simulator, webhook, and official native adapters.

sections.title: Runtime mode
sections.body: SIMULATOR_MODE=true forces safe synthetic behavior. SIMULATOR_MODE=false uses live konektor and fails closed without configuration.

sections.title: Publisher pengaturan
sections.body: Use /app/pengaturan/publisher to inspect mode/policy, test webhook delivery, and review recent deliveries.

campaigns.title: Kampanye Komentar
campaigns.description: Discover posts, generate drafts, approve, and send.

sections.title: buat a kampanye
sections.body: Define platform, mode (default approval_required), delays, daily limits, agent, and linked akun. Attach listener for keyword/competitor discovery.

sections.title: Pipeline
bullets: comment.send executes due actions through konektor router

sections.title: Step-by-step
steps: Go to /app/kampanye and buat a kampanye in approval_required mode.
Attach healthy akun and set delay/daily limits.
buat a listener with keyword or competitor query.
Run listener.poll + comment.generate (or worker:tick).
buka /app/persetujuan, edit if needed, approve selected drafts.
Run comment.send and verify /app/activity + delivery logs.

sections.title: Review flow
sections.body: buka /app/persetujuan to inspect draft text, risk flags, knowledge/skill markers, and decide approve/reject. Approved items schedule paced sends.

sections.title: Safety defaults
sections.body: persetujuan-wajib is the default kampanye mode. High-risk skills can force persetujuan even when kampanye are set to auto.

content.title: Kampanye Auto Post
content.description: Generate original posts and publish on an interval.

sections.title: buat content kampanye
sections.body: Provide topic, platform, post count, interval, start time, and opsional agent/akun. Drafts can require persetujuan before scheduling.

sections.title: Publish path
sections.body: content.generate creates drafts; content.publish sends due scheduled posts through the hybrid publisher konektor and records delivery logs.

sections.title: Step-by-step
steps: buka /app/content/new and define topic, platform, interval, and post count.
Generate drafts (persetujuan mode recommended).
Review and approve pending content drafts.
Confirm schedule in the content calendar.
Run content.publish or worker:tick for due posts.
Inspect publisher deliveries under /app/pengaturan/publisher.

workers.title: Worker & Job
workers.description: Background execution for health, discovery, generation, and send/publish.

sections.title: How to run
sections.code:
npm run worker:tick
# or
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/worker/run ^
  -H "Authorization: Bearer %WORKER_SECRET%" ^
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" ^
  -d "{\"job\":\"worker.tick\"}"

sections.title: Agents UI
sections.body: buat/edit personas under /app/agents. Each agent has tone, language, system prompt, knowledge docs, memory entries, and a playground.

sections.title: Knowledge ingest
sections.body: Upload text knowledge, lalu run knowledge.ingest to chunk content. Retrieval ranks chunks into comment generation context.

skills.title: Skill & Jalankan CoT
skills.description: Tool execution with visible reasoning steps.

sections.title: Runs timeline
sections.body: Inspect /app/runs for step-level chain-of-thought. High-risk skills can force persetujuan even in auto kampanye.

sections.title: Routing model
sections.body: kampanye/Agent -> Aether AI Router -> OpenAI-compatible gateway (e.g. 9Router) -> local rule-based fallback.

billing.title: Billing & Midtrans
billing.description: Snap checkout, voucher, and subscription activation.

sections.title: Checkout flow
bullets: Notification webhook verifies signature and activates plan limits

sections.title: Local simulation
sections.body: Without MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY, checkout uses simulation tokens and can mark orders paid via /app/checkout/result for development.

sections.title: Step-by-step
steps: buka /app/checkout and choose 1 / 6 / 12 month plan.
Optionally apply a voucher code.
Complete Midtrans Snap (or local simulation without keys).
Confirm subscription status in /app/pengaturan/billing.
Verify bulanan send/publish limits updated for the workspace.

sections.title: Configure
sections.body: Workspace admins set issuer, entry point, certificate, and email domain under /app/pengaturan/keamanan. opsional ssoRequired enforces SSO policy.

sections.title: Access
sections.body: Users with platformRole=superadmin can buka /admin for workspaces, users, billing, voucher, konektor, jobs, SSO, regions, flags, and audit.

sections.title: Compliance stance
sections.body: Aether is positioned as managed engagement sosial operations with guardrails, not a spam farm or ToS-bypass toolkit.

command-center.title: Command Center Walkthrough
command-center.description: How to read /app as an operator dashboard, not just a landing route.

sections.title: buka the command center
steps: Sign in and buka /app.
Confirm the active workspace in the shell.
Scan cards/widgets for health, pending persetujuan, and recent activity.

inbox-activity.title: Inbox & Activity Walkthrough
inbox-activity.description: Follow discovered posts and outbound outcomes end-to-end.

sections.title: Inbox
sections.body: Inbox lists discovered target posts and the latest generated draft state.
steps: Run a listener poll so new target posts appear.
buka /app/inbox and inspect author/platform/content.
If a draft exists, note status (pending/approved/sent).
Jump to persetujuan when draft review is wajib.

sections.title: Activity
sections.body: Activity is the operator-facing trail of kampanye actions and send outcomes.
steps: buka /app/activity after approve/send cycles.
Confirm scheduled vs sent vs gagal states.
Use gagal rows to debug konektor/policy/limit issues.

sections.title: When to use which page
steps: AI quality issues -> /app/pengaturan/ai and agent knowledge.
Live publish/send failures -> /app/pengaturan/publisher.
Limit error -> /app/pengaturan/billing.
Enterprise login policy -> /app/pengaturan/keamanan.

golden-path.title: Demo Golden Path
golden-path.description: A complete simulator demo path from signup to audited send.

sections.title: Goal
sections.body: Prove the full control-plane loop in mode simulator before enabling live konektor.

sections.title: Run this path
steps: Google signup -> buat workspace.
Add proxy + social akun + active sesi record.
buat agent and upload one knowledge doc; run knowledge.ingest.
buat persetujuan-wajib kampanye + listener.
Run worker:tick (health, poll, generate).
Review drafts/skills, edit if needed, approve.
Run comment.send and verify activity + audit log.
buat one content kampanye, approve drafts, publish due posts.
opsional: buka /app/checkout and simulate billing activation.

sections.title: Pass criteria
bullets: No live external calls while SIMULATOR_MODE=true

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting Overview
troubleshooting.description: Start here when something looks wrong in simulator or mode live.

sections.title: Triage order
steps: Confirm runtime mode: SIMULATOR_MODE true/false.
Confirm Anda are in the correct workspace.
Check /app/notifications and /app/activity for recent failures.
Check /app/pengaturan/publisher for konektor policy and webhook health.
Re-run the smallest worker job that reproduces the issue (not always worker.tick).

sections.title: Most common symptoms
bullets: Login loops or missing workspace after Google auth
voucher invalid or order stuck pending

sections.title: Where to look
bullets: Live delivery issues -> konektor & mode live page
Draft pipeline issues -> persetujuan & Empty Inbox page

troubleshoot-auth.title: Auth & Workspace Issues
troubleshoot-auth.description: Fix Google login, onboarding, and membership access problems.

sections.title: Login keeps returning to /login
steps: Verify AUTH_SECRET, AUTH_GOOGLE_ID, AUTH_GOOGLE_SECRET are set.
Confirm Google OAuth redirect URI includes /api/auth/callback/google.
Confirm APP_URL / AUTH_URL match the origin Anda buka in browser.
Clear site cookies for localhost and retry /signup.

sections.title: Signed in but redirected to onboarding forever
steps: Complete workspace creation form (name wajib).
Check database connectivity (DATABASE_URL) and prisma db push.
Confirm Membership row exists for Anda user with status active.

sections.title: Forbidden on billing/pengaturan actions
sections.body: RBAC blocks actions by role. Billing and some pengaturan require elevated roles.

sections.title: Cannot buka /admin
steps: Ensure Anda user platformRole is superadmin.
UPDATE User platformRole to superadmin for Anda email.
Sign out/in and reopen /admin.

troubleshoot-workers.title: worker & Jobs Issues
troubleshoot-workers.description: Debug worker auth, job names, and empty execution results.

sections.title: worker API returns 401
steps: Set WORKER_SECRET in .env.local.
Send Authorization: Bearer <WORKER_SECRET>.
Restart dev server after env changes.

sections.title: Invalid job error
sections.body: Use only names exposed by GET /api/worker/run or npm run worker:* scripts.

sections.title: Job succeeds but UI looks unchanged
steps: Confirm the job message/count in JSON response.
Hard refresh the related page (/app/inbox, /app/persetujuan, /app/activity).
Ensure data belongs to the active workspace.
For generate jobs, ensure there are target posts with status new.

sections.title: Recommended debug sequence
steps: sesi.health_check
listener.poll
comment.generate
comment.send (only after persetujuan exist)
content.publish (only when drafts are scheduled/due)

troubleshoot-connectors.title: konektor & mode live Issues
troubleshoot-connectors.description: Fix fail-closed live actions, webhook auth, and policy mismatches.

sections.title: mode live fails with not configured
steps: Check SIMULATOR_MODE=false only when ready.
Set SOCIAL_PUBLISH_WEBHOOK_URL or official API credentials.
Confirm konektor policy in /app/pengaturan/publisher.
Use Test webhook before enabling auto sends.

sections.title: Publish webhook returns 401
steps: If SOCIAL_PUBLISH_WEBHOOK_TOKEN is set, sender must pass the same bearer token.
If token is empty, receiver is buka (dev only).
Retest from /app/pengaturan/publisher.

sections.title: Official adapter fails and no fallback
sections.body: If policy is official_only, webhook fallback is disabled. Prefer prefer_official or prefer_webhook until native credentials are complete.

sections.title: Still seeing simulator behavior
steps: Confirm process env actually loaded SIMULATOR_MODE=false (restart dev server).
Check worker response mode field.
Ensure one-off tests are not forcing mode simulator.

troubleshoot-approvals.title: Persetujuan & Inbox Kosong
troubleshoot-approvals.description: Why drafts do not appear and how to recover the pipeline.

sections.title: Inbox empty after poll
steps: Confirm at least one active listener exists.
Run listener.poll and inspect job count.
In mode live, discovery can fail closed if konektor is misconfigured.
In mode simulator, poll should buat synthetic target posts.

sections.title: No rows in /app/persetujuan
steps: Ensure target posts exist with status new.
Run comment.generate.
Confirm kampanye/agent context is available.
Refresh /app/persetujuan and /app/inbox.

sections.title: Approved but not sent
steps: Check whether action is scheduled in the future (delay window).
Run comment.send after scheduledFor is due.
Inspect batas penggunaan (bulanan send limit).
Inspect konektor result message in activity/delivery logs.

troubleshoot-billing.title: Billing & voucher Issues
troubleshoot-billing.description: Checkout, Snap, voucher validation, and pending orders.

sections.title: Snap token/buat fails
steps: If MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY missing, app should use local simulation path.
With keys present, verify sandbox vs production flags match the keys.
Check server logs for Midtrans error messages.

sections.title: Order stuck pending
steps: Pending is normal for unpaid/unsettled transactions.
Ensure notification endpoint is reachable by Midtrans.
For local dev without Midtrans, use simulation result path to mark paid.
Recheck /app/pengaturan/billing order status after settlement.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.description: Short answers to the questions operators and integrators ask most.

sections.title: Apa itu Aether?
sections.body: Aether adalah control plane operasi sosial enterprise untuk Instagram, Threads, dan TikTok. It centralizes akun, persetujuan, automation, AI drafting, billing, and auditability.

sections.title: What is the difference between simulator and mode live?
sections.body: mode simulator synthesizes discovery/send/publish results for safe demos and CI. mode live uses webhook and/or official konektor and fails closed when credentials are missing.

sections.title: Are kampanye auto-send by default?
sections.body: No. Default kampanye mode is approval_required so humans can edit/approve drafts before outbound actions.

sections.title: Do I need Midtrans keys for local development?
sections.body: No. Without MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY, checkout uses a local simulation path so Anda can still validate plan activation UX.

sections.title: How does 9Router fit in?
sections.body: Aether can call any OpenAI-compatible gateway. 9Router is the recommended hybrid gateway so provider keys stay outside Aether while generation still has tiered fallback.

sections.title: Why does the worker API return 401?
sections.body: POST /api/worker/run requires Authorization: Bearer WORKER_SECRET. Missing/mismatched secrets are rejected.

sections.title: Why is persetujuan empty?
sections.body: persetujuan appear after comment.generate creates drafts from target posts. If listener never poll or generate never runs, the inbox/persetujuan stay empty.

sections.title: How do I access /admin?
sections.body: Only users with platformRole=superadmin can buka the platform admin console. Promote Anda user in the database, lalu sign out/in.

sections.title: Is SSO wajib for all workspaces?
sections.body: No. SSO/SAML is opsional per workspace. Enable and optionally force it under /app/pengaturan/keamanan.

sections.title: Where do I go next if still blocked?
bullets: Reproduce with the smallest worker job and capture the JSON response

index.title: Referensi API
index.description: HTTP endpoints for worker, billing, and konektor callbacks.

sections.title: Authentication
sections.body: Browser sesi auth protects app routes/server actions. worker and some webhook endpoints use bearer secrets/tokens.

worker.title: API Worker
worker.description: Trigger background jobs over HTTP with bearer auth.

sections.title: Authentication
sections.body: Send WORKER_SECRET as Authorization Bearer token (or x-worker-secret header).

sections.title: GET /api/worker/run
sections.body: List allowed job names and current runtime mode.

sections.title: POST /api/worker/run
sections.body: Execute one job. Invalid job names return 400; bad secrets return 401.

billing.title: Webhook Billing
billing.description: Midtrans Snap checkout, voucher validation, and settlement notifications.

sections.title: POST /api/billing/midtrans/snap
sections.body: Creates a workspace order and returns Snap token/redirect URL.

sections.title: POST /api/billing/midtrans/notification
sections.body: Midtrans server-to-server notification. Signature is verified when MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY is set.

sections.title: POST /api/billing/voucher/validate
sections.body: Validates a voucher for the selected plan before checkout.

publish-webhook.title: Webhook Publish
publish-webhook.description: Local/live receiver used by the hybrid publisher konektor.

sections.title: POST /api/publish/webhook
sections.body: Accepts publish payloads from Aether mode live. opsional bearer token via SOCIAL_PUBLISH_WEBHOOK_TOKEN.

sections.title: Operator tips
bullets: Point SOCIAL_PUBLISH_WEBHOOK_URL at this receiver or Anda n8n/custom worker.
Use /app/pengaturan/publisher Test webhook before enabling live kampanye.
Keep SIMULATOR_MODE=true until deliveries look correct.
